Maya (CSM): Heads-up — Sunrise Retail just told me they're ready to expand next month. They want to onboard 3 new teams: analytics, in-store POS, and returns ops. Saw a ~3x throughput spike during the pilot this week.
Owen (AE): Nice! Do we have rough numbers on concurrent qps / token volume? Need to scope any Dedicated ask for the renewal.
Maya (CSM): Quick summary from their pilot: embeddings-heavy for analytics (similarity search), gen/chat for POS prompts, and batched reranking for returns. They hit rate limits yesterday on hosted.
Lina (SE): Can you paste the rate-limit / 429 logs or sample traffic shape? sequence length, typical batch sizes?
Maya (CSM): Pasting their perf notes:
```
peak concurrent reqs: ~180
embeddings qps: ~120
gen qps: ~30
avg tokens per gen: 450
pattern: short-embed bursts + sporadic long-gen sessions
```
Maya (CSM): They also said they'd like low-latency for POS (under 200ms p95) during checkout spikes.
Alex (Sales): Sounds like a Dedicated conversation. Renewal in 6 months but we should propose a pilot reserved pool now. @Owen can you own commercial? I can thread solutions with finance. :moneybag:
Owen (AE): I can. Need costed proposal and ability to guarantee the latency SLO for POS team. Lina — can we confirm a config that meets p95 <200ms at 180 concurrent reqs?
Lina (SE): Likely need a mix: 1) quantized 4-bit gen model variant for POS, 2) dedicated smaller pool for low-latency, 3) prefix/KV caching for analytics to avoid regen of embeddings. I'll run a perf sim tomorrow.
Maya (CSM): They'll accept a short proof-of-concept: 2-week dedicated pool for POS + analytics caching. They want a rollout plan and enablement docs for 3 teams.
capacity-bot: Note: available Dedicated pools in region us-west-2: small(2xA100), medium(6xA100), large(12xA100). Current utilization medium=72%.
Alex (Sales): Suggest medium pool for pilot, with scheduled autoscale to burst if needed. I'll ask for a committed reduction discount if they sign early.
Owen (AE): Action items: 1) Lina to validate config & perf sim (ETA tomorrow) 2) Maya to collect sample prompts + user journeys from each team 3) Alex/Owen to draft pilot SOW and pricing by EOW.
Maya (CSM): I'll get prompts and a 1-page enablement checklist for each team today. Can @Lina also outline required IAM/network for Private deployment if they ask?
Lina (SE): Yep — I'll include VPC peering notes and KMS options.
Maya (CSM): One risk to flag for renewal: if POS has >200ms p95 misses in pilot, they may request SLAs or consider alternative vendors. So we need clear monitoring dashboards and a rollback plan.
Alex (Sales): Agreed. Add a dashboard snapshot and a CI-style perf test in the SOW.
Maya (CSM): Cool. I'll schedule a kickoff with Sunrise next Tue 10am PST and invite all. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Owen (AE): Thanks — will prep commercial template.
Lina (SE): On it, will post sim results in this thread.
capacity-bot: Scheduled maintenance window for us-west-2 on 1718400000; recommend avoiding pilot cutover on that date.
